paragraphs.text:
You roll to the side and press yourself up against the door 
frame, hastily dodging away from the spot Joshua shoots at. 
He curses under his breath as he levels the gun at you yet again. 
However, the slight pause between shots is all you need. Your 
instincts take over and you lunge at him, attempting to wrestle 
the weapon from him.

You knock him over with the force of your tackle. You 
grapple with him, clutching desperately for the gun.

• Make a Fighting (Brawl) roll: if you succeed, go to 143; if you 
fail, go to 152.
